; OSIS: who counts as religious, for the first-time model (Virginity). By name, built from the SkyrimNet bios of the NPCs of the base game and a few mods: only
; a name and our own label for each, no bio text. A virgin woman who is religious is always shy in her first consensual scene; one who worships Dibella starts as balanced,
; vocal or wild. NPCs in the vanilla temple and priest factions (and Markarth's Temple of Dibella) count too, whatever this file says.
;
; name|religious or name|dibella   (name: lowercase, anything but letters and digits as one space)
;
; Do not edit this file (a new version of the mod replaces it). Put your own lines in npc_religion_user.txt in this folder, in the same format; they win. A line with
; "none" (name|none) takes someone out.
